name: Flat
blurb: No outlines, lavender and sunshine fills, floating confetti
mechanism: Big shapes carry no outline at all: form is described only by thin white fold strokes laid on flat fills, plus a handful of navy hairlines, so the figure reads as cut paper with chalk creases.

rules: No outlines on big shapes; white fold strokes do all the shading.
Navy only for hair, sneakers, face features and a few hairlines.

One hero prop, in a colour the clothes don't use.
